config.loss: squared error (0.5*sum over classes), averaged over the complete minibatch

dataset: 1000 train and 1000 disjoint test examples from official 60000 training images
preprocessing: float32 image/255, exact area resize to 3x3, learner transforms 4*x-0.5
selection: Width/epochs/lr selected on disjoint pilot seeds 20261120-20261130 (24-config sweep, evidence/pilot_results.json); frozen before official evaluation. The accepted H32 anchor config scored 68.17% on the same pilot draws versus its official 67.08%
training: Fresh seed-101 initialization per draw; fixed supplied sample order; gradients from pre-update weights; no learned state transfer
evaluator: Two-phase: freeze (hash predictions, no evaluation-label slices) then score (verify hashes first)
source_sha256_note: Computed and recorded in submission.json at packaging time
